pillar_reactions.evidence: 'Training and mobility, do you feel like that makes sense, I see myself doing that?' — 'Yeah, no, I have no issue with that.' Pressed for more, he was open rather than enthusiastic: 'I'm not against it. Like, I mean, I'm here to learn. So if this is the route you want to go, I mean, I'm all for it. I have nothing to say against it, because I haven't done this before.' He did volunteer genuine appreciation for the personalisation: 'I do like the whole personalized aspect of it, because you do ask what it is I do for a living, how that incorporates into my daily life... It's different from someone that's sitting behind a desk in an office building.'

He went past acceptance into volunteering his own worst behaviour unprompted: 'I'm not afraid to change my diet at all.' and then the story of joining a colleague's weight-loss regimen by having 'a cigarette and a coffee until noon, and then I'll just eat whatever the hell I want.' He closed with 'I'm willing to make whatever type of dietary changes I need. It's just the guidance I need.'

'Sounds good? Yeah, that sounds good to me.' No questions and no elaboration on the check-in and video-feedback loop, which is notable given he had already identified guidance as his single missing ingredient — the pillar that answered his stated need drew the flattest response of the three.

anchors.raw: there's all types of videos you can find on, like, different exercises to do with it, and so I started playing around with it
anchors.note: He had bought a kettlebell a week earlier and was already self-teaching from free video. The offer had to beat a course of action he had begun and was enjoying — 'I think I like it more than anything.'

anchors.raw: one of the divers on my crew, he's about 280 pounds. I mean, you really don't need to be that in shape to do what I do.
anchors.note: His occupational environment sets a very low fitness bar, which removes external pressure to act. The rep noticed and pushed back lightly ('what if you're thriving 100%') but never returned to it.

anchors.raw: I basically need to pay for my lodging arrangements there before per diem... I do still have my rent due on the 1st, and that's already going to be about $1,200
anchors.note: Roughly $2,700 of committed near-term outgoings against $4,000 of available cash, disclosed only under pressure late in the call. Had the financial picture been taken properly at the start of the OC play, this would have been known before four descending offers were made.

anchors.raw: it really didn't kick until I found myself a teacher, and not only did I have their time involved in that whole situation, but also I'm paying them money, so, you know, double bubble on that
anchors.note: The strongest supportive anchor available and he produced it himself: he already pays a Japanese teacher, believes paid instruction is what made the difference, and generalised it to fitness — 'if you're truly dedicated about something, you need to get yourself an actual teacher. I've seen it happen with my Japanese. No reason why it should be any different with something physical.' The rep affirmed it but never used it to hold the price.

unmet_demand.want: To simply pay the full $6,000 in one or two weeks when his insurance reimbursement lands
unmet_demand.why_unmet: This is not a product gap — it is what he asked for and what the business ostensibly wants. There is no documented policy allowing a rep to accept a deferred full payment and hold the start date, so the rep improvised deposits instead of taking the deal on the terms offered.

unmet_demand.want: Assurance that loaded training is appropriate one month after throat surgery
unmet_demand.why_unmet: No clinical assessment exists in the offer and none was sought. The surgery was the reason he was buying and nobody established what, if anything, his surgeon had said about exertion.

unmet_demand.want: Programming built around the specific physical demands of commercial diving — upper-body pulling, 100 lb of surface equipment, repeated ladder climbs
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep gathered this detail well and it was genuinely distinctive, but the response was the standard three-pillar pitch with a general assurance that Trevor customises. Whether the method has anything specific for occupational loading of this kind was never established.
